positive_prefixed_citations.dāṇ: Maitreya 627 actually gives praṇiyacchati in the garland example. The general 1.1.20 Kāśikā has the distinct luṭ reading prāṇidātā in this digital field. The Bhāṣya records praṇidātā. Neither entry is silently respelled.
positive_prefixed_citations.deṅ_do_dheṭ: The Bhāṣya lists praṇidayate, praṇidyati and praṇidhayati under its discussion of including the root before śit transformations. The Kāśikā makes the subject and object of the last example explicit: the calf suckles its mother.

pada: The saṃ-conditioned special middle of dāṇ in 1.3.55 carries further syntax; neither ordered pair here contains saṃ.
surface_sources: All four pra+ni third singulars have whole-word support. The two complete preverb sets are written extensions under 8.4.17.
